needs: commands.test in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json set to "npm test", so the tests gate runs this repo's new test suite and the coverage gate can read coverage/lcov.info. It is currently null, which was correct when the repo had no tests and is now stale.
why: This PR brings the repo's first tests and the runner that executes them: node's built-in test runner, via a new `test` script in package.json, adding no dependency. The suite runs green here (31 tests, 98.04% line coverage of src/) and writes coverage/lcov.info in the format `bsf gates coverage` reads. But .factory/sandbox/ is a protected path and gardening may only change code and tests, so I cannot set commands.test myself. Until the manifest is amended on the default branch, `bsf gates tests` resolves the test command to `none` and reports neutral, and `bsf gates coverage` finds no report and — with floor_pct at 0 — also reports neutral. The gates therefore pass without having run a single one of these tests. runbook.md and history.md both predicted this exact hand-off: 'whoever adds it should also set commands.test through an amendment so the gate stops being blind'. .factory/definition/context/runbook.md also still says 'This repo has no tests' and 'commands.test is null', which the definition pipeline should correct in the same amendment.
